sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' (1 point) and /26 'Parking Lots' (1 lot), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (leaf-off) 300 m frame around 38.0756,-91.8890, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Six-acre river access on the Gasconade south of Vienna, with a concrete boat ramp, privy and paved lot at the end of a gravel lane through farm fields. The primitive camping is in the open grove of trees just north and west of the lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites', one mapped primitive camping area in the grove beside the paved lot, free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is on it. Riverview not supported: the camp is ~60 m from the Gasconade behind the access lane and a 25-35 m wooded bank - suggest not waterfront. Area page phone differs from the stored one.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; the map shows a 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol in the wooded grove north-west of the parking lot, and GIS has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point (38.07563,-91.88911, the stored pin) 32 m NW of the lot (38.0754,-91.88888, Paved, ADA 'Yes', Allows_Trailers 'No'). Imagery: an open grassy grove of scattered trees beside the paved lot, reached on a gravel lane (CR 513 then the access lane) - drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview): suggest DOWNGRADE to not waterfront. Measured: the camping point is ~59 m from the Gasconade's west bank (the river is ~75 m wide); between them run the gravel access lane and a 25-35 m band of riparian trees, which shows as dense trunks even leaf-off and is full canopy in summer. No open sightline from the camp to the water is visible; the only opening is the boat-ramp corridor ~70 m SE of the camp. The area page's 'campsites and a lovely view' caption sits on a photo taken from the ramp (it shows the ramp and the river, no campsite), and a ramp view is not evidence for the camp. Unsure resolves down.
PHONE: the area page now lists (573) 815-7900 (MDC Central Region office); the entry stores 573-897-3797 - suggest updating to the area page's number.
Pin is the GIS camping point in the grove - fine.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, the site-length line and the directions dropped.
